# October 2026 patch-release trial

This plan covers the three `yizha1` forks.

## notation-core-go

Current: `v1.3.2-monthly-test.202610`  
Proposed: `v1.3.3-manual-review.20261018`

- [CBOR: 2.9.4 to 2.9.6; x/crypto: 0.57.0 to 0.58.0](https://github.com/yizha1/notation-core-go/pull/17).
- [actions/upload-artifact: 7.0.1 to 7.0.2](https://github.com/yizha1/notation-core-go/pull/16).
- [actions/checkout: 4 to 7](https://github.com/yizha1/notation-core-go/pull/15).

## notation-go

Current: `v1.3.4-monthly-test.202610`  
Proposed: `v1.3.5-manual-review.20261018`

- [LDAP: 3.4.14 to 3.4.15; x/crypto: 0.57.0 to 0.58.0; x/mod: 0.41.0 to 0.42.0; ORAS: 2.6.2 to 2.6.3](https://github.com/yizha1/notation-go/pull/15), plus transitive dependency updates.
- [actions/upload-artifact: 7.0.1 to 7.0.2](https://github.com/yizha1/notation-go/pull/13).
- Adopt the proposed Core release above.

## notation CLI

Current: `v1.3.4-monthly-test.202610`  
Proposed: `v1.3.5-manual-review.20261018`

- [pflag: 1.0.9 to 1.0.10; x/term: 0.46.0 to 0.47.0; ORAS: 2.6.2 to 2.6.3](https://github.com/yizha1/notation/pull/25).
- [Test dependencies: Ginkgo 2.33.0 to 2.33.1; Gomega 1.40.0 to 1.44.0](https://github.com/yizha1/notation/pull/25), plus transitive dependency updates.
- [codecov/codecov-action: 5.4.2 to 7.1.1](https://github.com/yizha1/notation/pull/22).
- [actions/stale: 9.1.0 to 11.0.0](https://github.com/yizha1/notation/pull/21).
- [actions/checkout: 4.2.2 to 7.0.1](https://github.com/yizha1/notation/pull/20).
- [actions/add-to-project: 1.0.2 to 2.0.0](https://github.com/yizha1/notation/pull/19).
- [github/codeql-action/init: 4.38.2 to 4.38.3](https://github.com/yizha1/notation/pull/18).
- Adopt the proposed Core and Go releases above.

**Status:** awaiting scope approval. The stale-action PR has a failing check. Fork execution setup is still pending; nothing has been released.

To approve this scope, comment `/approve` on this issue.
